==gimste==
*Currently, Simple English definitions in jbopvlaste are being reused by me for La Bangu dictionary. The changes are removing "by standard" places for most (but not all) smuvelcki where they exist, strictly specifying what tersumti what sumti type can accept.

*gimste must clearly specify sumti types.
**currently known sumti types: object, nu, ka, du'u, quote, lu'a-concept, li, ma'oi, ra'oi
*gimste must clearly specify sumti interactions ala gua\spi (e.g. x3+1,2)
